import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Order_ID'], keep='first')
    allowed_categories = ["Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"]
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip().str.title()
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].apply(lambda x: x if x in allowed_categories else pd.NA)
    df = df[ (df['Quantity'].astype(int) == df['Quantity']) & (df['Quantity'] >= 1) ]
    df = df[df['Price'] >= 0]
    df = df[df['Category'].notna()]
    return df

def answer(df):
    return df['Category'].value_counts().to_dict()
